name: Mail Archiver
description: Mail Archiver delivers automated archiving of incoming and outgoing emails from multiple accounts. All email content and attachments are synchronized based on a schedule. The responsive UI is optimized for mobile and desktop use, is multilingual and responsive with dark mode. OpenID Connect (OIDC) can be configured for integration of external authentication services.
short_desc: A comprehensive solution for archiving, searching, and exporting emails
